nphi.title: Strengthening Biosecurity in Southeast and Eastern Europe (Biosecurity SEEE)
nphi.with: Georgian NCDC; Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology; GIZ; BACAC; WHO; US DTRA; ISTC; STCU
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated needs-based biosafety and biosecurity capacity building, including national assessments, pathogen inventories and train-the-trainer courses in Georgia.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P44 – CBRN preparedness and response enhancement in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (Belgium); ISEM Institute; IRE-ELiT
nphi.summary: RIVM led the work package that produced a country report for each of the nine partner countries, plus train-the-trainer materials and exercise guidance, to strengthen how first responders handle CBRN incidents.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P57 – CBRN crime scene forensics in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (coordinator); Netherlands Forensic Institute; INCC Belgium; Forensic Science Centre Ivan Vučetić; ISEMI
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which trained forensic investigators to collect evidence at CBRN incident scenes, wrote procedures, and ran six sub-regional exercises.

nphi.title: STEP – immunisation policy capacity
nphi.summary: Building technical capacity for evidence-based decisions on immunisation policies in 16 countries of the WHO European Region.

nphi.title: XBM:TB phase 2 – Cross-border tuberculosis management Germany–Poland–Moldova–Romania
nphi.with: Institute of Tuberculosis and Lung Diseases (Warsaw, Poland); 'Chiril Draganiuc' Institute of Pneumology (Chișinău, Moldova); 'Marius Nasta' Institute of Pneumology (Bucharest, Romania)
nphi.summary: Structured information-exchange protocols to keep TB treatment continuous for patients moving between Germany and partner countries and to monitor outcomes.

nphi.title: PACT-PHM – Partnerships for population health metrics capacities and tools
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (Denmark); Sciensano (Belgium)
nphi.summary: Builds national capacity to produce burden-of-disease and other population health metrics and embed them in health information systems for policy use.

nphi.title: SeqNET+ – Genomic diagnostics and surveillance of lung pathogens, focus drug-resistant TB
nphi.actor: Research Centre Borstel, Leibniz Lung Centre (FZB)
nphi.with: Ospedale San Raffaele (Italy); Inselspital Bern (Switzerland); Eswatini Ministry of Health (NTRL, NPHL, NTCP); Baylor College of Medicine Eswatini; Baylor College of Medicine Houston (USA); Instituto Nacional de Saúde (Mozambique); University of Namibia School of Medicine; National TB Reference Laboratory, Phthisiopneumology Institute (Moldova); WHO Regional Office for Europe; German Central Committee against Tuberculosis (DZK)
nphi.summary: Strengthens sequencing-based diagnostics and molecular surveillance of drug-resistant tuberculosis and other lung infections, with training and health-system integration.

nphi.title: ECDC MoUs with EU Enlargement countries
nphi.actor: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.with: Country signatories not named on the page
nphi.summary: MoUs signed in Stockholm on 28 April 2025 that formalise 14 years of cooperation. They cover information exchange on cross-border threats, observer participation in ECDC networks, and are a prerequisite for data-sharing agreements.

nphi.title: PulseNet Eastern Europe and Central Asia regional network
nphi.with: National Agency for Public Health (Moldova, regional coordinator); Georgia (member); CDC Eastern Europe and Central Asia Regional Office
nphi.summary: PulseNet International's newest regional network started in 2025 with Georgia and Moldova as full members and Moldova's National Agency for Public Health as coordinator. CDC's EECA regional office in Tbilisi supports it, and feasibility…

nphi.title: EUCanScreen – European Joint Action on Cancer Screening
nphi.with: Ukrainian and Moldovan partner institutes not named on the source pages; RIVM coordinates the Dutch participation
nphi.summary: Supports countries in implementing the updated EU cancer screening recommendations, covering breast, cervical, colorectal, lung, prostate and gastric cancer.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: EUCanScreen – implementation of cancer screening programmes
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: University of Latvia (host organisation); 29 partnering countries incl. 25 EU states, Norway, Iceland, Ukraine, Moldova
nphi.summary: Multi-country project implementing cancer screening programmes; Slovenia's NIJZ participates alongside partners from EU and non-EU countries including Ukraine and Moldova.

nphi.title: EUCanScreen – cancer screening implementation
nphi.actor: Latvian Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC)
nphi.with: University of Latvia (host); partner organisations in 29 countries
nphi.summary: SPKC participates in work packages on cancer screening in a multi-country project that also includes Ukraine, Moldova, Norway and Iceland.

nphi.title: Health resilience in the Eastern Partnership – preparedness and response component
nphi.actor: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (mental health and workforce components); national public health authorities of the Eastern Partnership countries
nphi.summary: EU-funded initiative in which ECDC helps the Eastern Partnership countries assess and strengthen their preparedness for serious cross-border health threats. The work includes regional simulation exercises, workshops, webinars, an expert…

nphi.title: CDC Eastern Europe and Central Asia Regional Office (EECA)
nphi.with: Ministry of health counterparts (not named); regional FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's EECA regional office in Tbilisi (2021) supports ten countries on AMR, hepatitis C elimination, genomic sequencing, lab quality, surveillance, workforce development and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: SECID – South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases
nphi.actor: SECID / Institute of Public Health, Albania (SEEHN)
nphi.with: South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases (Tirana); South-eastern Europe Health Network (SEEHN); national public health institutes of the region; CORDS network; assisted by US CDC
nphi.summary: Regional centre set up in Tirana in 2013 under SEEHN, linked to Albania's Institute of Public Health, that supports national authorities across South-East Europe on influenza and respiratory-pathogen surveillance, pandemic preparedness…

nphi.title: NIPH global health security partner countries
nphi.with: WHO; IANPHI; Africa CDC; ECDC; US CDC
nphi.summary: NIPH lists Malawi, Moldova and Palestine (besides Ghana) as partner countries for IHR capacity, national public health institute strengthening and emergency preparedness.

nphi.title: EMIS-2023 – European MSM internet survey extended to Eastern Europe/Central Asia
nphi.with: Deutsche Aidshilfe (Germany); ECOM – Eurasian Coalition on Health, Rights, Gender and Sexual Diversity; SEE RCN – South Eastern Europe Regional TB and HIV Community Network
nphi.summary: Extended online health and behaviour surveys among MSM to EECA and Western Balkans to strengthen HIV/STI surveillance.

nphi.title: Sero-B – Hepatitis B serosurvey preparation in Eastern Europe/Central Asia
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe
nphi.summary: Technical support to prepare serosurveys evaluating hepatitis B vaccination impact.

nphi.title: COVIMPACT Hepatitis – Corona Global – COVID-19 impact on hepatitis elimination in EECA
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe
nphi.summary: Assessed pandemic impact on hepatitis B/C elimination programmes and supported recovery strategies.

nphi.title: EURO NITAGs – Strengthening NITAGs in middle-income WHO EURO countries
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe – VPI Programme
nphi.summary: Built capacity of immunization advisory groups for evidence-based recommendations.

nphi.title: CEI Know-how Exchange projects: distance learning on epidemics and pandemic outbreaks
nphi.with: National health institutes and ministries (not named)
nphi.summary: Two ISS-led projects, funded by Italy through the Central European Initiative (CEI), trained national health institutes in Belarus, Moldova, Ukraine and the Western Balkans on epidemic and pandemic response.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: SHARP JA – Strengthened International Health Regulations and Preparedness
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Wales (UK partner); THL (coordinator); RIVM; NIJZ; AGES; Switzerland took part as a collaborating partner with its own funding
nphi.summary: A joint action to help countries implement the International Health Regulations and strengthen preparedness for serious cross-border health threats, including laboratory capacity and chemical threats.

nphi.title: SeqMDRTB_NET – Sequencing against drug-resistant TB
nphi.actor: Research Centre Borstel, Leibniz Lung Centre (FZB)
nphi.with: Eswatini Ministry of Health; Baylor Children's Foundation (Eswatini); Ospedale San Raffaele (Italy); National TB Center (Kyrgyzstan); National Institute of Health (Mozambique); Institute of Phthisiopneumology 'Chiril Draganiuc' (Moldova); University of Namibia School of Medicine; IML (Germany); National Reference Lab for Mycobacteria / WHO SRL (Germany)
nphi.summary: Introduced NGS to predict TB drug resistance in high-incidence countries and built a competence network.

nphi.title: Joint WHO Europe–IANPHI seminars on building NPHIs through mergers
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Regional Office for Europe; merged NPHIs of Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden, UK
nphi.summary: WHO Europe and IANPHI held three seminars, in Kyiv (2017), Warsaw (2018) and Moldova (April 2019). Merged NPHIs from Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden and the UK shared their experience with countries setting up NPHIs: Ukraine, Moldova,…

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.
